subject: Crossflow: MAP kickoff + SE/ML introductions (Veloce)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@veloce.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crossflow: MAP kickoff + SE/ML introductions (Veloce)

Alex —

Thanks for the time last week. I wanted to pull together a short Mutual Action Plan draft and introduce the technical leads who will partner with you during the evaluation and rollout. The goal is to run a focused MAP that gets Veloce to a production decision by the target close date (proposed: 2026-12-18).

High level:
- Timeline: 5–6 week evaluation window, weekly syncs, mid-MAP checkpoint for model quality review.
- Roles: Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) — leads performance/latency tests, infra validation.
  Karthik Iyer (ML Engineer) — leads eval metrics, dataset ingestion, model variant testing.
  I (Priya) will manage milestones, procurement cadence, and executive updates.

Attached is the first draft of the MAP (Veloce_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx). Can you confirm the right technical contacts on your side (engineering lead + data owner) and whether the Dec 18 close target is realistic? Also: are there procurement or legal blockers we should surface now (DocuSign link will follow once scope is locked).

Proposed kickoff call: Tue 2026-11-16 10:00am PT — 30 minutes (intro + agree scope and first deliverables). If that works I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

—
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Veloce_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@veloce.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crossflow: MAP kickoff + SE/ML introductions (Veloce)

Priya —

Thanks, and appreciate the clear plan. Confirming that I’m the engineering lead on this engagement; I’ll also loop in Rahul Mehta (our ML Eng manager) for the technical deep dives. Dec 18 as a close target is ambitious but doable if we keep to a tight cadence — happy to try for it.

Kickoff on Tue 11/16 10am PT works for me. Please send through a short agenda and any pre-read (we’ll aim to have a sanitized sample dataset and a short SLO checklist ready).

A couple quick asks up front:
- Can Ben outline the exact infra access / allowlist requirements so our security team can get approvals early?
- We expect to use DocuSign for the SOW; can your procurement lead confirm the party names and billing contact so we can prep internal approvals?

I’ll reply-all once I’ve added Rahul and our procurement contact.

—
Alex Turner
Engineering Lead, Veloce
alex.turner@veloce.io

To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@veloce.io>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crossflow: MAP kickoff + SE/ML introductions (Veloce)

Alex / team —

Thanks — I’ll take point on the infra checklist and run the performance plan. I’m attaching a short kickoff runbook and a proposed 30-minute agenda for Tue 11/16:

Agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: Introductions / MAP goals
- 5–12m: Success criteria & KPIs (latency targets, quality thresholds)
- 12–20m: Scope for initial eval (datasets, endpoints, access)
- 20–27m: Roles, deliverables, weekly cadence
- 27–30m: Next steps / action items (who owns what this week)

Pre-kickoff checklist (items we need from Veloce by 11/15):
- Allowlist IPs and service account for test cluster
- Sanitized sample (<=50k rows) upload (link preferred)
- List of evaluation prompts and target metrics (F1 / exact match / qualitative pass/fail items)

Attachments: MAP_Kickoff_Runbook.md (text/markdown)

I’ll put a calendar invite on Priya’s proposed time. If you prefer a different slot, let us know.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Rahul Mehta <rahul.mehta@veloce.io>

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crossflow: MAP kickoff + SE/ML introductions (Veloce)

Thanks for the intro — Rahul here (ML Eng manager at Veloce). I’ll join the kickoff on Tue 11/16. Quick notes from our side:

- We can provide a sanitized sample dataset (CSV) and upload it to the Drive folder linked below by EOD Monday. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-sanitized-sample
- Primary KPI for this eval is end-to-end median latency <= 250ms and p95 <= 550ms for the 512-token baseline. Cost target: under $18 / 1M tokens for the evaluation footprint (we can flex on accuracy thresholds if latency/cost tradeoffs are clear).
- We’ll also share a short prompt set and expected pass/fail rules (5–10 representative cases).

Looking forward to the runbook — Ben, if you can include the service account and IP ranges for allowlisting that’ll speed approvals on our side.

—
Rahul Mehta
ML Engineering Manager, Veloce
rahul.mehta@veloce.io
